instruction.text: Complete the text by choosing a fitting additive linking word from the options provided.

atoms.b: Taking a gap year allows young people to gain independence. ((++Furthermore ++Moreover --And)), it provides a unique opportunity to learn soft skills that cannot be taught in a classroom.
((++In_addition_to --Also --What_is_more)) experiencing the world, students learn a great deal about themselves. Many discover new passions that influence their future choice of degree.
Educational institutes ((++also --besides --and)) tend to view gap years positively, providing that the time was spent productively.
((++Moreover ++Furthermore --As_well_as)), employers value the real-world experience that gap year students often bring to the workplace.

instruction.text: Combine the sentences using not only … but also.

atoms.a: She speaks Italian. She writes Italian perfectly.
The book is entertaining. The book is educational.
The city is famous for its architecture. The city is famous for its food.

instruction.text:
Read carefully. Complete the text by choosing the most fitting additive linking words. You cannot use a word more than once.

also – as well as – besides – in addition

hint.text: When linking words appear at the beginning of a sentence, there's a comma placed right after them to separate them from the main clause. If they are accompanied by additional information,  the comma is shifted to after the addition.
hint.label: Linking words and commas

atoms.b: The “Fast Fashion” industry is having a devastating impact on our planet. The constant production of cheap clothing consumes vast amounts of water ((++as_well_as)) generating tonnes of textile waste that ends up in landfill sites. ((++In_addition)), the chemicals used to dye these clothes often pollute local rivers and water sources. We must ((++also)) consider that many labourers work in unsafe conditions for very low wages. ((++Besides)) the environmental and ethical issues, the quality of these clothes is often so poor that they fall apart after just a few washes.
